interpretation.memory_limit_calibration: Inconclusive for a hard limit: 192 MiB ArrayBuffer/Wasm and heap burst returned successfully; incremental heap reconstructed after 144 MiB; Wasm and heap burst reconstructed after 192 MiB while ArrayBuffer kept its instance. The memory metric responded to calibration, but no exceededMemory outcome was captured.
interpretation.network_scope: Current workstation route to Cloudflare SJC; no direct-path or proxy-buffer isolation.
interpretation.retirement_recommendation: Continue the Cloudflare route; separate logical generation retirement from host residual admission risk. Preserve live credit and bounded admission. Do not infer immediate physical release or a finite TTL; do not reset a whole share to clean up one slow peer.
